items.title: Amazon routes new Brand Store pages through an AI agent first
items.excerpt: Amazon's Brand Store builder now starts new pages with an AI agent: brand owners get six starter prompts, output fixed to one language, and an All Deals tab that fills itself.
items.rationale: A shipped change to how every Amazon seller builds a Brand Store: new pages now start from an AI agent, with set limits brand owners need to know before the holiday rush.

items.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
items.excerpt: AWS Quick added a Meta ads AI connector backed by Meta's ads MCP server, so advertisers can create, manage and analyze Meta campaigns in natural language alongside their own data and creative tools.
items.rationale: A primary-source launch: Meta's ads MCP server is now wired into AWS Quick, so teams can create and analyze Meta campaigns in natural language next to their own data.

items.title: Google AI Mode ads appear as deep as the fourth follow-up question
items.excerpt: Sponsored phone and case carousels followed two turns of one Google AI Mode conversation; US advertisers cannot opt out of multi-turn placements and Google gives no per-turn reporting.
items.rationale: Shows that AI Mode ads now run deep into follow-up turns, and advertisers can neither opt out of those placements nor see per-turn reporting, which affects how they budget and measure.

items.title: Bitmovin AI Brings Scene-Level Ad Signals to Google Ad Manager
items.excerpt: Bitmovin integrated its AI Scene Analysis with Google Ad Manager, passing scene-level contextual signals from video content into ad decisioning to improve video ad targeting.
items.rationale: A new integration that sends AI scene analysis into Google Ad Manager decisioning, so video publishers and buyers can target ads by scene context instead of by user.

items.title: The first agentic AI Black Friday is off to a rocky start
items.excerpt: AI shopping agents like Meta's Muse were expected to do much of this year's holiday buying, but expired listings, blocks from Amazon and eBay and low consumer trust are slowing the first agentic Black Friday.
items.rationale: A timely reality check before Black Friday: expired listings, retailer blocks and low shopper trust are holding back agent-led buying, which matters for how retailers split holiday spend.
